usage: The word '新抱' (san1 pou4) is a noun used to refer to a daughter-in-law in a casual way.
It is mostly used in informal family conversations or among relatives.
'新抱' can be used as the subject or object in a sentence without any change in form.
You can add possessive markers like '我個新抱' (my daughter-in-law) to indicate relationship.
When addressing or talking about the daughter-in-law, it's common to use '新抱' to sound familiar and warm.
